verdict.rationale: Employee referrals are a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but the evidence pack never documents a referral flow. Nothing shows employees submitting referrals, tracking their status, or seeing where a referral stands. The candidate-create API, stages endpoint, and webhooks are developer building blocks that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands
